# Data provenance (generated by DataReportTest, world created 21 Nov 2026)

What each game's starting world is built from. "Estimated" means the source did not give the
fact and the game filled it in (shown as *Estimated* on the player page's **Data provenance**
card). Ratings and attributes are always game estimates, never real measurements.

## Sources and limits

| Game | Source of current rosters | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| League of Legends | lolesports.com league pages (snapshot 20 Nov 2026); birthdays / nationalities from Leaguepedia (lol.fandom.com) | Verified rosters; facts matched only when the real name matches (same-handle mix-ups such as Peyz, Ruler, Caps, Knight are rejected) |
| Valorant | vlr.gg team pages (snapshot) | Verified rosters; 9 teams list fewer than 5 players — generated players complete them and are labelled *generated*; positions are estimates |
| Counter-Strike 2 | Valve Regional Standings on github.com (snapshot) | Verified rosters; the source has no positions, so every CS2 position is an estimate |
| Dota 2 | OpenDota (opendota.com, snapshot) | Verified team names and handles; nationality, birth date and position are estimates |
| Mobile Legends | MPL ID and MPL PH official sites (id-mpl.com, ph-mpl.com; snapshot) | Verified rosters for two leagues; three fictional leagues fill the other regions |
| Wild Rift | Wild Rift Esports Wiki — **early 2021** | Historical rosters, labelled on every team page; no current source could be used |
| Honor of Kings | none usable | Liquipedia answered HTTP 429 (rate limited) and earlier a CAPTCHA, which this project does not bypass; Wikipedia has no rosters. HoK leagues, teams and players are fictional and labelled so. With a Liquipedia (LPDB) API key the HoK and Wild Rift packs could be refreshed |

Characters: 724 champions / heroes / agents from game data sources (Riot Data Dragon, wildrift.leagueoflegends.com, pvp.qq.com, mlbbhub.com, OpenDota, valorant-api.com; 20 Nov 2026). CS2 has weapons, not characters.
